concepts.brief: 日常经营 HUD 与交互提示
concepts.prompt: Create ONE polished widescreen 16:9 PC GAME UI CONCEPT SCREEN for our cozy fantasy red panda shop game. Use the supplied Blender shop render as the actual background reference: preserve the isometric camera, room layout, existing furniture and warm golden window light, no redesign of the room. This is a UI mockup, not a website. Unified art direction: refined dark forest-green translucent panels, thin aged-brass borders, restrained parchment accents, cream highly legible typography, small botanical motifs, beautifully painted inventory icons; lightweight UI, not chunky mobile buttons. Mostly unobstructed shop. Top-left small red-panda portrait and short health/stamina bars. Top-right elegant coin counter '1,280' and compact '第 3 天'. Bottom-left small interaction prompt by the central potion display, with clear keyboard F keycap and exact Chinese text '查看商品'. Near the rear counter show subtle 'F 交互' contextual prompt. Bottom-right compact icon shortcuts with readable labels '背包 B', '订单 J', '装修 R', '设置 Esc'. Bottom-center discreet status '营业中'. Include a small tasteful tab label '01 日常经营' at top center to identify the mockup. Maintain PC readability, large enough Chinese labels, no giant quest list, no characters inserted into scene, no fake mouse cursor, no logos/watermarks. Crisp high-quality finished game interface composited on the supplied environment, warm and sophisticated, not childish.

Create ONE polished widescreen 16:9 PC GAME UI CONCEPT SCREEN, '02 背包与物品'. Use the supplied isometric warm shop render as the background, preserve room layout and lighting; slightly dim background behind modal. Same UI system: dark forest-green panels, slender antique-brass borders, parchment detail cards, warm ivory readable Chinese typography, subtle botanical corners, painterly PBR-style item icons. A large centered inventory window occupies 75% width with generous margins. Header '背包', top-right X close button. Tabs '全部' '装备' '药剂' '材料' '任务'. Left main section a regular 6-column by 4-row slot grid, mix filled and empty slots, beautiful individual icons for swords, potions, herbs, ores, rolled cloth, keys; consistent rarity border indicators with small textual badges, stack counts. Header currency '1,280'; bottom capacity '18 / 24' and restrained button '整理'. Selected RED potion has gold focus outline. Right distinct item-detail panel with large potion icon, title '恢复药剂', type '消耗品', concise description '恢复少量生命值。', quantity '数量 5', and two large clear action buttons '使用' and '移入仓库'. Footer key hints '右键 查看' 'Esc 关闭'. Layout credible for mouse and keyboard, strong visual hierarchy and spacing, no microscopic paragraphs, no character equipment paper doll because not confirmed. No shop repaint, no characters or watermark. Render as a finished game screenshot UI concept, not a browser.

Create ONE polished widescreen 16:9 PC GAME UI CONCEPT SCREEN labeled '03 订单选择'. Preserve the supplied cozy isometric shop render as a subtly dimmed backdrop. Match elegant forest-green, parchment and antique-brass UI with warm cream Chinese lettering, botanical edging and beautifully illustrated item icons. Main wide centered modal titled '今日委托', subtitle '选择一份委托，也可以自由出发'. Three equal customer order cards across the center, each with a modest NON-chibi fantasy human customer portrait (herbalist, guard, traveler), clear customer name/title, 2 requested item icons, quantities and a coin reward. Use short readable Chinese, e.g. card titles '药师的补给', '巡卫的装备', '旅人的行囊'; reward labels '报酬 120', '报酬 180', '报酬 150'. First card selected with a tasteful brass frame and check indicator. Main footer states '最多接取 1 份订单'. Two equally findable actions below: primary '接取选中订单' and secondary '不接订单，直接出发'. Small Esc close hint. Communicate free choice, no forced acceptance, no multi-order checkbox list, no paid currency or monetization symbols. Restrained mature fantasy style, genuinely practical mouse/keyboard target sizes, readable text, balanced composition. No new people placed in actual 3D shop, only card portrait illustrations. Single complete interface screenshot, not a collage, no watermark.

concepts.brief: 装修、家具目录与摆放预览
concepts.prompt: Create ONE polished widescreen 16:9 PC GAME UI CONCEPT SCREEN labeled '04 店铺装修'. Use the supplied actual isometric warm shop render, preserving the room and lighting. Same cohesive PC fantasy UI: forest-green translucent surfaces, thin antique-brass trim, ivory Chinese typography, restrained botanical details and painted furniture icons. Top small bar '装修模式', coin count 1,280, close X. A compact furniture catalog along the LEFT 24% screen width with tabs '家具' '装饰' '灯具' and 2-column thumbnails: chair, chest, herb pot, rug, bookcase, lantern. Selected item detail at lower-left title '盆栽蕨叶' with ownership '拥有 2'. Keep the middle room highly visible. Show one tasteful translucent green fern-pot placement ghost ONLY in an open aisle edge near the front-left bench, with a subtle small floor grid confined to its vicinity and green 1x1 footprint. Floating context hints next to ghost: '左键 放置', 'R 旋转', '右键 取消'. Bottom-center compact actions '撤销' and '完成装修'. Existing furniture is unchanged; do not fill the whole room with giant grids. No inaccessible text, no modern web dashboard look, no characters, no watermark. Prioritize distinguishing selected catalog item, placement validity and cancel/confirm actions while preserving cozy shop atmosphere.

concepts.brief: 按钮、提示与交互状态对照
concepts.prompt: Create ONE high-resolution widescreen 16:9 GAME UI COMPONENT EXPLORATION BOARD for the same cozy fantasy red panda shop. Use reference image solely for its warm wood/stone/greenery/brass palette, NOT as the board background; clean dark desaturated forest-green background. Title in elegant clear Chinese '05 交互与按钮规范'. Cohesive refined PC game interface kit, aged brass thin outlines, cream typography, dark green panels, restrained parchment inserts and botanical motifs. Arrange five orderly sections with substantial spacing: (1) '主按钮' a row of the SAME button labeled '确认', demonstrating states labeled below '默认' '悬停' '按下' '不可用', distinguish state by contrast, border and depth; (2) '次级操作' buttons '取消' '返回' '整理'; (3) '交互提示' keycap F with '查看商品', keycap B with '打开背包', keycap Esc with '关闭'; (4) '物品格' six square icons, potion, sword, herb, crystal plus selected and empty states, restrained rarity and stack-count treatment; (5) '反馈与确认' a small confirmation modal title '移入仓库？' with '确认' and '取消', beside short success toast '已放入背包' and warning toast '背包已满', icons as well as colors. High-end coherent fantasy game UI, no web browser chrome, no overwhelming filigree, readable precise Chinese text, practical generous hit areas. Clearly a concept board for discussion, not implementation code. No logos or watermark.
